# Windows 98 Theme Showcase

Welcome to the **Windows 98** theme showcase for MemWault. This theme is a bit-for-bit recreation of the classic 1998 Microsoft Windows desktop environment, complete with active desktop paradigms, floating gadgets, authentic icon suites, and retro assistants.

## Dashboard & Active Desktop

The Windows 98 theme replaces the standard dashboard with an authentic retro desktop paradigm:
- **Floating Active Desktop Gadgets:** Configure widgets (Memory Counter, Quick Actions, System Health, Audit Log) floating directly on your wallpaper.
- **Authentic Desktop Icon Suite:** 18 handcrafted pixel-perfect SVG reproductions of authentic 16-color/256-color Windows 98 icons (`MemWault.exe`, `FeedViewer.exe`, `Memories.exe`, `Journal.exe`, `StoryReels.exe`, `Collections.exe`, `WorldAtlas.exe`, `Cabinet.exe`, `Setup.exe`, `Display.exe`, `RecycleBin.exe`).
- **Desktop Icon Backdrop Boxes:** Customizable 3D beveled silver backdrop boxes around desktop icons for crystal-clear readability over busy or bright custom wallpapers.

## Story Detail & Journal

The Memory Studio takes inspiration from classic Windows applications like Notepad and DevStudio, featuring retro syntax-highlighted JSON viewers and classic inset text areas.

![Story Detail Editor](../../screenshots/memory_journal_tab.jpg)

## Display Properties (Wallpapers & Gadgets)

A true highlight of this theme is the authentic **Display Properties** modal:
- **Continuous 3D Tab Strip:** Property sheets for Background, Widgets & Desktop, and Sound FX.
- **Live CRT Monitor Preview:** Real-time mini CRT viewport rendering active wallpaper and desktop icon backdrops.
- **Local Mobile QR Uploads:** Transfer wallpapers and photos directly from your smartphone via QR code.
- **Icon Readability Toggle:** Turn on retro backdrop boxes for desktop shortcuts with a single click.

## MemWault Assistant (Clippy)

MemWault includes an authentic animated **Clippy Assistant** positioned in the bottom-right corner:
- **Interactive Knowledge Base:** Type what you want to do (e.g. "how to upload wallpaper", "sync instagram", "replace with raw", "restore deleted stories") to receive step-by-step instructions.
- **Direct Navigation:** Jump straight to any relevant screen or modal with one click.
- **Dynamic Collision Avoidance:** Automatically glides upward when system tray monitors or popups are active.
- **Fully Customizable:** Toggle Clippy on or off anytime via Settings or Display Properties.
